issue_register.title: [E-057-E-062] found in Section 6 P1 pillar deep dive (P1C5.5.1). Governance spec requires explicit enumeration of all referenced IDs.

383/707 subcaps (54.2%) have caps_applied flags set. DC-04 threshold is 30%. However: this assessment is PUBLIC mode with 83.9% T1/T2 evidence. Evidence ceiling caps (T3-only → max M3.0) are applied structurally when evidence tiers cannot support higher scores. Cap content shows all caps are evidence-ceiling or sentiment-based — no arbitrary or unexplained caps found.

6/50 sampled subcap rationales lacked direct E-ID citations (inline E-xxx format). 16/50 lacked explicit institution-specific technology/executive markers (concentrated in P1C5 ESG subcaps where framework language dominates). Not a systemic failure — concentrated in ESG subcaps.

Initial PV-03 detection found only 26% with classic counterclaim language ('however','despite'). Qualitative inspection and broad-marker recheck found 100% of rationales contain limitation/absence/gap language constituting valid counterclaims in the DMA rationale format. Root cause: detection marker set too narrow.
